text:
marta: Quick check — planning a narrow-slice, regioned canary for model v13. Goal: validate latency/cost and generation quality before a wider percent ramp. Planning timeline: start tomorrow 09:00 UTC, 1% NA + 1% EU for 30m -> 5% -> 20% (24h windows).

kevin: sounds good. what flags are we touching?

marta: flag name is `flags.model_v13_canary`. We'll scope by region + user segments: `region=NA|EU` and `audience=eng-internal,beta-users`. Default route still v12 for pinned customers.

lina: please add SRE guardrails: auto-kill if p99 latency > 2x baseline OR upstream error rate > 0.5% for 10m. Also abort on generation-quality regressions from eval set (~drop in relevance score > 3 points).

raj: I can wire up the auto-kill in Gatekeeper. Proposed rule snippet I added to the toggle service:
```json
{
  "flag": "flags.model_v13_canary",
  "stages": [
    {"percent": 1, "regions": ["NA","EU"], "duration_min": 30},
    {"percent": 5, "regions": ["NA","EU"], "duration_min": 60},
    {"percent": 20, "regions": ["NA","EU"], "duration_min": 1440}
  ],
  "abort_conditions": {
    "p99_latency_multiplier": 2.0,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5,
    "quality_drop_points": 3
  }
}
```

sam: devex note — please include the fallback mapping for pinned traffic in the flag UI so support can validate. Also add `reason` and `owner` fields to toggle so we have an audit trail.

ana: (eng-ml) quick note: for quality checks we'll run the standard regression harness against the prompt corpus every stage. If failing, we'll tag samples and run a small manual review (ana+ml-evals). I can own the eval webhook.

kevin: oncall? lina, can you confirm who gets paged on auto-abort?

lina: on auto-abort, page `eng-oncall` and `ml-platform` channels. Also send a short message to the rollout thread via deploy-bot. I'll add a playbook step: immediate rollback -> analyze logs -> reopen canary when fixed.

marta: deploy-bot, schedule toggle ramp tomorrow 09:00 UTC for 4 hours first window. tag: @kevin @lina @ana @raj @sam

deploy-bot: scheduled `flags.model_v13_canary` ramp at 2026-03-19T09:00:00Z. will post updates to this thread. :white_check_mark:

raj: quick config note — ensure the routing policy prefers quantized v13 variant in edge cases to reduce cost if we've got memory pressure. fallback order: v13-quant -> v12-quant -> v12-full.

kevin: small ask — can we add a `slow-path` header so SDKs can opt-out of batching during canary for more deterministic latencies? helps explain p99 blips.

sam: yes, add header `X-Redwood-Canary-Deterministic: true`. I'll update SDK doc and include a one-liner snippet for curl usage.

marta: testing checklist before go: 1) Gatekeeper rules in place 2) Auto-kill pager + playbook linked 3) Eval webhook wired 4) Support flagged in console 5) SDK header doc updated. Mark each here when done.

raj: Gatekeeper rules: done. added abort threshold and webhook -> deploy-bot.

lina: pager config done, playbook link: https://wiki.redwood/rollouts/playbooks/canary-quick.json

ana: eval webhook wired and smoke tests pass — will kick off regression at each stage.

sam: SDK doc updated + header implemented in JS/Python clients. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/sdk/pull/421

kevin: support flag in console added and audit fields included.

marta: great. leaving final go/no-go at 08:30 UTC tomorrow. if anyone sees issues overnight ping here.

raj: one more — metrics to watch in the first 30m: p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, and eval-quality delta. I'll create a dashboard and share link here before rollout.

marta: perfect. thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin: thanks — i might join the first window to shadow.

lina: i'll be oncall and watching dashboards.

deploy-bot: `flags.model_v13_canary` scheduled, dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/boards/mdl-v13-canary (will post live signals).
